qc/README.md; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md; NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md and TASK_AUTHORING_WORKFLOW.md (applicable runtime/lifecycle guidance)
evidence: The public workbook row 19 overrides its historical internal no-network annotation; no external fetch is needed here. Frozen solution/solve.sh:1-36 has a bash shebang, LF bytes, set -euo pipefail, an exact /app database reset after inactivity checks, and cp -a into /app; it writes no /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution content, invokes no pkill and sets no NODE_ENV=production. server.js:2 enters src/index.js; bootstrap.js:18-45 supplies database-independent health and the 0.0.0.0 PORT listener in one Node process, while db.js:13 honors DB_PATH, :14 uses the copied seed, and :122-179 transactionally seeds once. The copied seed bytes equal environment/assets/seed_data.json. Both images preinstall the two declared dependencies. Indexed install-isolation-result.json (SHA256 d1422983d1bb26d5a649ed98b044213e4c9fd2aba8f0c33d8355500b93b20b24) records bash -n success and fresh installation with an unrelated unprivileged sleeper. Indexed install-lifecycle/results.json (SHA256 125aa681a04307790302ad83f62dec1db084392d8dee6519346cb57c31ed8dee) and its inspected driver show exact app-copy hashes, sanitized unprivileged launch from /tests, a newly saved requisition retained through actual restart_mcp replacement, single-use refusal, and stopped-workspace reinstall restoring 7 requisitions/13 offers. Its active reinstall exits on inability to inspect /proc and leaves the saved record intact; this is conservative refusal, not proof of an exact matching-FD detection. All cited indexed artifact hashes and the entire lifecycle app/source bindings were independently checked (evidence/19/hash-verification.json). A new offline cached-image probe also ran the frozen reference with PORT=3019 and DB_PATH=/app/custom/runtime.db: health/UI/login succeed, 7 users load, the override database exists, default app.db is absent, and /assets plus /instructions are absent. New run log SHA256 9faead26c929f712ae554af536c6ddbf10c000921aef59c8bd75b091be901125; driver SHA256 ea09e3eaf41b40315912c6f8e3a945bf0fb6704b10de68329ce5e5c7cb522e51. Broken alternative considered: a health-only shell or a restart that resets saved data would not satisfy the actual UI/login and persisted-requisition controls; an assets-dependent implementation would fail the no-assets probe. Conforming alternative considered: nondefault runtime port and database path are exercised successfully. Additional bounded observation: an inactive existing database plus an unrelated UID65534 sleeper causes EACCES refusal with database unchanged, and reinstall succeeds after the sleeper exits. The installer does not claim to reset safely while arbitrary unreadable processes remain; this conservative limitation is not a defect in the stated fresh/stopped-workspace and one-process contract. The initial new fixture used case-sensitive Set-Cookie lookup and failed after login; the original attempt is preserved, and the corrected fixture normalizes legal HTTP header casing. This row pass covers installation/runtime only. Full configured grading, judge duration, reward discrimination/ranking and hosted scores remain unmeasured and are not waived or inferred from these finite runs.
